text.p: Swedish brokerage house Ohman said on Friday that it had downgraded its trading recommendation on insurance company Trygg-Hansa to neutral from outperform due to recent strong moves in the share price.
Ohman's Mikael Garton said the share's performance had been very good in the past month.
"The share prices has grown a lot in the past month and we think it is near top levels now," Garton told Reuters.
He said Ohman saw 130 crowns as the right price for the insurer. Trygg-Hansa at 1215 GMT was trading two crowns higher at 133.50 crowns.
Garton said Trygg-Hansa's nine month report, released on Friday, was much as expected.
Trygg-Hansa reported a pre-tax profit of 2.10 billion for the nine months to September 30 compared to 2.09 billion a year ago.
However Garton said the shareholders' funds per share at 108 crowns was a bit disappointing. Ohman had expected this to reach 130 crowns.
